chooseLanguageSub: Mutha kuchisintha pambuyo pake mu Zosintha za pulogalamu.
darkModeSub: Sinthani pakati pa mutu wowala ndi wakuda
heroSub: Njira yosavuta yopezera, kufananitsa ndi kulumikizana ndi katundu ku Kenya konse.
missionBody: Property Konnect ikufuna kupangitsa kupeza katundu kukhala kosavuta, kolumikizana komanso kopepuka kwa anthu ku Kenya konse.
whoWeServeSub: Pulogalamu imodzi ya aliyense amene akufuna, kapena akupereka, malo okhala kapena ogwirira ntchito.
studentsBody: Pezani ma hostel pafupi ndi sukulu yanu, lumikizanani ndi anzanu okhala nawo, gwiritsani ntchito za ophunzira ndipo lowani m'magulu a sukulu mu Malo a Ophunzira.
tenantsBuyersBody: Sakani ndi chigawo ndi chigawo chaching'ono, fananitsani zosankha ndipo lumikizanani ndi eni ake mwachindunji.
propertyOwnersBody: Lembani katundu wanu ndipo fikirani anthu omwe akufuna malo mwachangu.
whatYouCanFindSub: Sankhani Kubwereka kapena Kugula, kenako dinani gulu kuti muwone katundu wofananira.
whereWeCoverSub: Katundu m'zigawo zonse. Sankhani chigawo kuti muwone zigawo zake zing'onozing'ono.
journeySub: Kuyambira kupeza katundu mpaka kumupanga kukhala kwathu.
whyWideSub: Nyumba, ma hostel, ma apartment, malo amalonda ndi zina.
whyMobileSub: Yapangidwa kuti igwire ntchito bwino pa foni yanu.
whySmartSub: Sefani ndi chigawo, chigawo chaching'ono, mtundu ndi cholinga.
whySafeSub: Nenezani zotsatsa zokayikitsa ndipo werengani malangizo athu a chitetezo.
safetyBody1: Musanatumize ndalama kwa mwini, pitani kukawona katundu nokha ndipo onetsetsani kuti mukumasuka ndi malondawo ndi tsatanetsatane wake.
safetyBody2: Ngati muwona chokayikitsa mu chotsatsa, mutha kuchinenera pogwiritsa ntchito njira yonenera patsamba la tsatanetsatane wa katundu.
studentSectionBody: Malo a Ophunzira amasonkhanitsa malo okhala oyenera ophunzira, kulumikizana ndi anzanu okhala nawo, ntchito za ophunzira ndi magulu a sukulu.
verifyIntro: Tikutumizirani ulalo wotsimikizira pa imelo. Dinani Tsimikizirani imelo, kenako dinani ulalo mu imelo. Tsamba ili lipitiliza lokha.
waitingForClick: Tikudikira kuti mudinde ulalo. Tsamba ili lipitiliza lokha.
tapVerifyToSend: Dinani Tsimikizirani imelo kuti mutumize ulalo wotsimikizira.
checkSpam: Yang'anani chikwatu cha spam/junk ngati simukuwona imelo.
linkSent: Ulalo wotsimikizira watumizidwa ku imelo yanu.
linkInvalid: Ulalo uwu si wolondola kapena watha. Pemphani watsopano.
couldNotSend: Imelo siinatumizidwe. Yang'anani kulumikizana kwanu ndipo yesaninso.
tooManyRequests: Zopempha zambiri. Dikirani mphindi zochepa ndipo yesaninso.
incorrectEmailOrPassword: Imelo kapena mawu achinsinsi ndi olakwika.
